name: E. coli RNA polymerase elongation complex (core α2ββ′ω)

source.title: CryoEM structure of crosslinked E.coli RNA polymerase elongation complex
source.nucleicAcidSource: synthetic scaffold (entity source: Enterobacteria phage T7)

additionalSources.title: Cryo-EM structure of Escherichia coli hairpin-nucleation complex of transcription termination (TTC-hairpin)
additionalSources.usedFor: hairpin anchor (termination hairpin closing base pair and stem axis)

additionalSources.title: E. coli 70S-RNAP expressome complex in NusG-coupled state (38 nt intervening mRNA)
additionalSources.usedFor: expressome anchor, coupledMrna path, and coupling distance D

superpositions.matching: P atoms of rRNA residues matched by auth_seq_id and equal residue name (DEC-011)

coupling.countingMethod: Inclusive nucleotide count from first nucleotide of the ribosome P-site codon (AV:16 A, paired with P-tRNA AW) through the RNA 3'-terminal nucleotide in the RNAP active site (AV:53 G, paired with template CT): 53 - 16 + 1 = 38 nt (0 unmodelled nucleotides in span; matches 6ZTJ PDB title "38 nt intervening mRNA" and PLAN.md §6.4 24+D transcript length rule). Kept at D = 38 per PLAN.md §13 because ribosome-70s L1 at the expressome pose has zero clash with rnap-ec L1.

notes: Generated by tools/build-assets.mjs from the mmCIF files pinned in tools/sources.lock.json (model 1, altloc . or A, no hydrogens). Full provenance: docs/assets/rnap.md.

Asset frame (docs/CONTRACTS.md 6.3): origin = midpoint of the fitted base-frame origins of rna(-1) and template(-1); +z = least-squares axis through base-pair centres of template registers >= +2; +x = protein Calpha centroid direction perpendicular to z.
Base pairing rule: fitted base-frame origins within 2.5 A and antiparallel base normals, assigned one-to-one in order of increasing origin distance.
activeSite anchor: MG ion (label_asym I, auth J 1501), 2.05 A from O3' of rna(-1).

ntpEntry anchor (synthetic): 256-ray Fibonacci-sphere ray cast from activeSite excluding 35 deg around +/-z and rnaExit (185 rays kept; max min-clearance 6.418 A over 5-35 A; origin at 30 A, +z inward).
hairpin anchor: closing base pair I:10 (C) / H:-10 (G) of the 10-bp termination hairpin in 7YPA (superposed on beta/beta' Calpha, RMSD 1.161 A), +z along fitted stem axis toward the apical loop.

expressome anchor: places ribosome-70s (ribo frame) into the rnap frame from 6ZTJ (RNAP beta/beta' RMSD 1.021 A; 16S+23S P RMSD 0.625 A). Coupling distance D = 38 nt (AV:16 to AV:53 inclusive, 0 unmodelled); min ribosome-RNAP L1 distance 7.389 A.

coupledMrna path: 25 points (138.414 A) from rnaExit (synthetic) through observed 6ZTJ mRNA AV:41..23 (19 points, synthetic = 0) and a 5-step synthetic bridge to ribosome-70s mrnaEntry in the rnap frame.
L0: Gaussian density of Calpha beads (sigma 5 A, grid 5 A), marching cubes, welded, closed, outward winding; iso-level = 4.50th percentile of bead densities, 95.1 % of beads inside (ray-parity test).
L2: heavy atoms of protein residues with any atom within 12 A of activeSite, plus MG/ZN within 20 A; ions are assigned to the chain of their auth_asym_id.
Track frames with synthetic = 1 were interpolated (linear origin, slerp rotation) between fitted neighbours; their bases come from _entity_poly.
Nucleic-acid chains are tracks only; they are not part of L0/L1/L2.
